source: Cubic guide and two-load Hamiltonian of cubic_resonance_protocol.json. The relative address has one complex amplitude and no spin index. Use the stated address permutation lift of each spatial turn.
preparation: Use the uniform distinct-pair source, zero total momentum, time 1/8 and N=8,16,32. Compare the tuned threshold with exchange only and unmodified contrast 8. Retain the probability of maximum coordinate separation below 1/4.
diagnostic: Check that each perpendicular half-turn preserves the Hamiltonian and that their two orderings agree on every relative address. Compare the overlap of the two orders on the evolved packet with the same overlap for a Pauli spinor. Rephasing either turn equally in both orders cannot change the comparison.
decision: A positive commutator excludes spin half for this lift of the pair. A negative commutator is necessary but insufficient for electron identification. A Hamiltonian symmetry check is a representation calculation. No controlled observer interferometer, signed electromagnetic current, electron mass calibration or physical particle dictionary is assumed.
